notice: SYNTHETIC. The small web this world's agents can search and fetch: every page is invented for testing, under .example domains. A page's file is this folder's web/<host><path>. 'noise' marks a page an agent should leave alone; no tool or model sees it, the graders read it (web.no_noise_cited). 'fake' is what each agent's offline model is told about this world (the searches a person who knows the market would type); a live model writes its own. 'environment' is the note every search result and fetched page carries to the agent: it says this web is a synthetic market and that, within the exercise, it is the market. 'label' lists the synthetic labels the pages carry, for the graders (research.exclusion_not_on_label); no tool returns it.
